messages:
sasha (PM): kicking off PRD review for the 'Compact Rerank + Embeddings' API change. link: https://redwood.internal/prd/compact-rerank. Need clear acceptance gating + launch cut. TL;DR: add an optional rerank endpoint that accepts embeddings and candidate texts, returns ranked IDs + scores; default behavior falls back to model-based similarity when embeddings missing.

rahul (Eng): skimmed it. main engineering ask: keep the existing /completions and /chat contracts untouched. new endpoint should be `POST /v1/rerank` and be opt-in. we need request/response examples for SDKs and streaming behavior decided.

lin (ML): for ML-side we need: standard eval set (5k queries), lang coverage (en, es, fr, zh), and regression thresholds. propose: MRR >= 0.72 on canary set and no more than 1.5% drop vs current production for top-1 relevance on core intents.

maya (PM): proposed acceptance checklist (draft):
- API contract stable and documented in OpenAPI + SDK examples
- Integration tests exercising fallback path when embeddings omitted
- Eval >= threshold across 3 priority customers' datasets
- Perf SLOs: p95 latency < 220ms for small batch (N=8) on Dedicated tier
- Telemetry: per-request tokens/cost + rerank score histogram
- Rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with auto-rollback on quality regression

carol (Design): need clarity on the response shape so front-end can show confidence. suggestion: include `score` and `explain` (optional short reason). `explain` must be < 256 chars.

rahul (Eng): agree on shape but flag: `explain` could increase payload sizes. make it optional behind a `debug=true` query param. example response:```json
{"results":[{"id":"doc_123","score":0.87},{"id":"doc_456","score":0.62}]}
```

lin (ML): about scoring scale: normalize to [0,1] using softmin across candidates to avoid model drift across different queries. we'll provide a deterministic post-processing step in the repo.

maya (PM): customers asked for batch rerank and single-item use. we should support both. add acceptance: both single and batch modes covered by integration tests.

eva (SRE): perf/ops notes: must emit span with `rerank.variant` + `model_id` and ensure KV cache isn't poisoned by debug payloads. storage: keep only summary telemetry to limit PII. also need a canary capacity plan (gpu x 3) for first rollout.

rahul (Eng): implementation plan: week1 API + unit tests, week2 integration + perf harness, week3 canary rollout + collect eval metrics. blockers: SDK churn (we need one-week buffer for SDK releases).

lin (ML): edge cases to call out in PRD: identical candidate texts, zero-length candidate list, multilingual inputs with mixed-language candidates. acceptance: deterministic fallback ordering for identical scores.

sasha (PM): decision points for this thread:
1) accept `explain` only behind `debug=true` (consensus?)
2) gating: require MRR >= 0.72 AND no customer regressions >1.5%
3) perf SLO p95 < 220ms on Dedicated N=8
4) rollout gating automation to auto-rollback on quality regression within 2 hours
Please react with :thumbsup: to approve or :warning: to request changes.

rahul (Eng): :thumbsup: for the above.

lin (ML): :thumbsup: will prepare eval harness and share results in #eng-ml.

carol (Design): :thumbsup: good to go, will mock UI with `score` and `debug` toggle.

eva (SRE): :warning: add one item: define retention for telemetry metrics (30 days default) and ensure GDPR-safe defaults.

maya (PM): noted @eva (SRE) — adding retention and GDPR compliance to acceptance. updating PRD now.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window set for canary: 2024-06-12 02:00 UTC (pending approvals).

sasha (PM): thanks everyone — I'll merge PRD after maya's small update and publish to the roadmap board. follow-ups: rahul to post API swagger by EOD, lin to post eval plan by Thu, eva to confirm canary capacity.
